newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Indigo, Cerutti in marketing pact.
newsitem.headline: Indigo, Cerutti in marketing pact.

text.p: Israel's Indigo NV said on Tuesday that it had formed an alliance with Italy's Cerutti Group to market an Indigo printing system for packaging materials.

"The Cerutti Group has concluded an alliance with Indigo... for exclusive worldwide distribution and marketing of a new generation Omnius One-Shot Colour digital printing system," it said in a statement.
The Israeli maker of digital printing systems said the alliance would give it access to Cerutti's customer base, established over three generations, boosting its sales.
Cerutti manufactures gravure presses for packaging and special publication printing as well as flexo presses for printing newspapers and telephone books, Indigo said.
It said Cerutti under the initial two-year alliance would be able to follow the evolution of digital printing systems closely in the framework of the wider packaging materials market.
